name: 1903-va-after
about: An after hook on a function with `...` is refused at start (Hook.Variadic) and the mod stays off

has.text: va-after: code/windows-x64/mod.dll: luma_mod cannot be used: "MR::tryCreateCsvParser" takes a variable number of arguments, so it takes before hooks only; the function it passes them to with a va_list takes every hook.

va-after: code/linux-x64/mod.so: luma_mod cannot be used: "MR::tryCreateCsvParser" takes a variable number of arguments, so it takes before hooks only; the function it passes them to with a va_list takes every hook.
